proposal.reason: Main change adds host one-sided window/signal APIs (`pcclPutSignal`, `pcclSignal`, `pcclWaitSignal`) plus window/LSA validation behavior, which fits device-api. Additional copy-engine review is needed because the feature executes via new CE RMA init/put/wait paths with signal/ack synchronization. Additional enqueue review is needed for new RMA task/planner queues, batching, and launch routing. Additional communicator review is needed for capability/config/lifecycle integration (`numRmaCtx`, platform gating, init/finalize wiring).
